Reproducibility: yes. for the introduced patch regression: source inspection shows reused terminal sessions now call clearAllCliSessions even when the session id is preserved.

target.title: feat(durable): wire agent session runtime coordination
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

This PR wires the durable runtime foundation from PR2 into agent/session/subagent paths so OpenClaw can record durable context for chat sends, agent runs, subagent child runs, parent fan-in, yield progress, and restart/recovery inspection.

The target behavior is: parent agents should have durable child/fan-in state; one failed child should not make sibling completion invisible; and Gateway/session restart should leave inspectable runtime state instead of silent coordinator ambiguity.

## Dependency Chain

This is PR3 in the replacement durable runtime stack:

1. PR1: durable session/task runtime RFC v2.
2. PR2: durable runtime foundation.
3. PR3: agent/session/subagent wiring, this PR.

This branch is stacked on the refreshed PR2 branch. The upstream PR diff against `main` is cumulative. For delta-only review after PR2, use:

https://github.com/mjnkao/openclaw/compare/codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-foundation-v2-ready...codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-agent-v2-ready

## Summary

Adds:

- Gateway `chat.send` and `agent.run` durable context refs;
- user-turn transcript durable context propagation;
- embedded-agent yield progress for resumable parent turns;
- subagent child-run mirroring and parent fan-in association;
- task completion contract metadata for durable parent/child lifecycle;
- status-notice display metadata for durable/yield progress;
- protocol schema fields for durable context references.

## Explicit Non-Scope

- Planner/product modules.
- Board-style UI/tools.
- Projection adapters.
- Retention/compaction.
- Postgres/multi-worker lease contention.
- Durable write controls such as cancel/retry/resume/signal.

## Latest Reviewer Follow-Up

Updated on 2026-07-03 after the latest ClawSweeper default prompt guidance finding, durable context terminology cleanup, and proof refresh.

Head: `654dc5c5f9532630a775a6ef5579c531ff25f554`.

Addressed ClawSweeper findings:

- Default durable-disabled prompts again include ``Larger work: use `sessions_spawn`; completion is push-based.`` while durable-specific `Sub-agent orchestration` wording remains gated behind durable policy/runtime enablement.
- ACP manual-spawn CLI task suppression is limited to the trusted in-process `gateway-client` backend caller, excludes device-token auth, and still requires persisted ACP child metadata.
- Device-token backend and operator-write ACP-shaped calls keep CLI task tracking.
- Reused `failed`, `timeout`, and `killed` terminal session state is cleared only for visible user requests.
- Heartbeat/cron/internal terminal-session reuse preserves terminal status, timing, runtime, and abort markers.
- Durable agent/session test fixtures now use task/session-task terminology rather than module-specific work-unit examples; runtime behavior and schema compatibility are unchanged.
- Earlier QR display, oversized-history idempotency, default prompt compatibility, and durable foundation follow-ups remain fixed on this stacked branch.

Regression coverage added:

- `src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts` now asserts the default larger-work `sessions_spawn` guidance remains present, while existing tests keep durable orchestration wording on enabled paths only.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts` covers trusted ACP suppression, device-token ACP-shaped fallback tracking, operator-write ACP-shaped fallback tracking, plugin-subagent precedence, visible terminal reuse cleanup, and heartbeat terminal-state preservation.
- `src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts` covers agent event behavior after the Gateway agent-method changes.
- Durable fan-in/yield/subagent/intake tests cover bounded intake envelopes, yielded parent turns, subagent terminal fan-in, failed continuation visibility, and parent fan-in reopening for later children.
- Durable, gateway, agent-tool, history-omission, session-utils, and system-prompt shards were rerun to keep PR2/PR3 integration proof current.

## Evidence

Latest validation:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts src/durable/intake-envelope.test.ts src/durable/agent-turn.test.ts src/durable/subagent.test.ts src/durable/fan-in.test.ts`
  - 4 files, 17 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts`
  - 2 files, 358 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-tools.config.ts src/agents/tools/sessions-spawn-tool.test.ts src/agents/tools/gateway-tool.test.ts`
  - 2 files, 67 tests passed.
- `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check`
  - passed with `docs/docs_map.md is up to date`.
- `npm run tsgo:core`
  - passed.
- `git diff --check`
  - passed.

Earlier focused validation remains recorded in `docs/specs/durable-runtime-agent-session-pr-proof-2026-07-01.md`, including:

- Gateway/context/server-methods shard: 6 files, 176 tests passed;
- agent tools shard: 2 files, 67 tests passed;
- durable fan-in/subagent/agent-turn shard: 3 files, 14 tests passed;
- Gateway durable matrix: 2 files, 4 tests passed;
- QR sensitive pairing display regression: 2 files, 262 tests passed;
- oversized-history metadata regression shard: 7 files, 549 tests passed;
- server-chat agent events shard: 1 file, 99 tests passed;
- Gateway durable/history/session-utils shard: 7 files, 293 tests passed;
- durable orchestration prompt compatibility shard: 1 file, 92 tests passed;
- Kysely verify and guardrails checks passed;
- `npm run tsgo:core`, `npm run tsgo:core:test`, and `npm run tsgo:prod` passed on the stacked branch.

## Local Build Note

`env CI=true npm run build` was attempted locally. Dependency installation and bundled plugin assets completed, then the root `tsdown` build emitted only heartbeat lines for more than ten minutes and was manually interrupted. This is not recorded as passing build proof; CI or a maintainer machine should still run the full build before merge.

## Notes

This PR replaces the agent/session/subagent wiring portion of #97508 with runtime-oriented naming and a narrower dependency chain.
